Research stocks with Claude skills
A commenter uses Claude skills to research specific stocks and a separate tool for market and portfolio insights, rather than having Claude buy stocks.
·
Jul 1, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
One commenter said they do not let Claude buy stocks or act as an advisor. Instead, they set up Claude skills to research a specific stock, and use a separate tool, Astor, for broader market and portfolio insights; the source gives no further workflow details or human handoff beyond that separation.
How it went
The reported outcome is limited: they use Claude for stock-specific research and Astor for general insight, but provide no performance numbers, returns, or examples of results. They explicitly avoid using Claude to execute trades or make the final call.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Help me research [company name and ticker] as a possible investment. Cover what the business does, revenue and margin trends, debt, competitors, valuation compared with peers, and the top three risks, using the filings and articles I paste in or you can access. End with a one-page summary that separates facts from your own opinion, plus five questions I should still answer before making any decision myself.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/claude/comments/1u8nadg/anybody_used_claude_for_trading_or_buying_stocks
